item.title: On Lubricating the Niz Plum Topre Keyboard (to Get Rid of Spring Noise)
item.author: yihua.zhou@outlook.com (Simon Zhou)
item.description: This article introduces how to open up a Plum Niz Topre Keyboard and eliminate the spring noise by lubricating the spring.
